reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: the RLS UPDATE policy at migrations/0000_create_member_schema.sql:83 exists and is active — RLS policies are enforced on every UPDATE to member.members; no caller-count check applicable (not a function). Gate 2: entry point is a direct, unauthenticated-tier REST API call by any authenticated user to the Supabase REST endpoint — no trust_assumptions section in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json and the attacker is untrusted. Gate 3: supabase/migrations/ is explicitly in-scope and 'Admin role check enforcement (is_admin boolean in member table)' is listed as a key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via the Supabase REST API by sending PATCH /rest/v1/members?supabase_auth_user_id=eq.<their_uuid> with body {"is_admin": true} and their own session JWT, causing immediate self-escalation to admin and full access to all admin routes and data.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: SG-006: Permission_level must only be modifiable by admin users through admin user management endpoint
